company.name: Zerocater
company.shortDescription: Zerocater builds corporate catering and cafeteria solutions employees love as they transition to the hybrid workplace.
company.description:
Zerocrater is a platform for office catering and snacks that allows users to select from a number of food options and have them delivered to their workplace from eateries. The platform of the company provides catering meals to small and medium-sized enterprises and simplifies the ordering procedure, allowing clients to create a high-performing office culture by bringing employees together over food.

Zerocrater was established in 2009 in San Francisco, California by Arram Sabeti.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $15,000,000, or 39.58% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,985,946 to $166,594,911, a 23.85x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 47 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
